Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the paternal grandfather as Louis Philippe I, Duke of Orléans (1725–1785), confusing the generations among similarly named Orléans princes. Charles’s father is Louis Philippe I (the king, 1773–1850), whose father—and thus Charles’s paternal grandfather—is Louis Philippe II, Duke of Orléans (Philippe Égalité), not the earlier Louis Philippe I, Duke of Orléans (who would be Charles’s great-grandfather).
